import html # Predefined template for blog posts. BLOG_FORMAT = """

{title}

{body}
""" def show_blog_post(headline: str, text: str) -> str: """ Return a sanitized and formatted blog post ready for safe display. Parameters ---------- headline : str The heading of the blog post. text : str The main text content of the blog post. Returns ------- str A string containing the sanitized and formatted blog post. """ # Escape any HTML special characters to prevent injection safe_title = html.escape(headline, quote=True) safe_body = html.escape(text, quote=True) # Format the sanitized content into the template formatted_post = BLOG_FORMAT.format(title=safe_title, body=safe_body) return formatted_post
